Expected: Standardize placeholder text across all dropdowns for UI consistency.

Critical API Latency on Mandatory Verification Flow Violating SLA (>25s-30s):
Network tab analysis reveals unacceptable API latency across the core onboarding flow: RequestOTP took 29.52s, eKYC took 25.34s, and TransliterationServicesEng2Hindi took 21.61s (total page load/transliteration finishing in >28-30s). This drastically violates standard citizen portal performance SLAs (<3s) and will lead to widespread gateway 504 timeouts in production.

Modal Responsiveness Failure on Viewport Reduction (Content & Consent Checkbox Clipped):
When the browser viewport width is reduced (e.g., tablet view, 13" laptop, or DevTools open), modal dialogs (Aadhaar Auth & Member Registration) fail to scale responsively due to fixed CSS widths. The modal overflows the viewport, causing the top instruction text, left border, and bottom mandatory consent checkboxes to be clipped completely off-screen with no scrollbar.
on aadhaar ekyc page, Encirled text are not tranlated into hindi.png

Modal Centering & Alignment Failure (Anchored Flush Left to Viewport x=0):
Modal dialogs across the onboarding flow lack proper flexbox/grid viewport centering. Modals render flush against the extreme left edge of the browser window (x: 0), cutting off card padding, boundary shadows, and instruction text, rather than dynamically centering in the user's active viewport.

DOM Duplication: Stutter / Offset Duplicate "Ok" Button in Success Alert Modal:
When the "OTP Sent Successfully" modal appears over the Member Registration dialog, two separate "Ok" action buttons are rendered concurrently (a green primary button stacked slightly offset above a dark grey button), indicating duplicate DOM element generation or unmanaged action button states in the modal component template.
